verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents deleting files and folders through its Files API (dropbox-docs-3). Its plans set deleted-file recovery windows of 30 days, 180 days or 1 year, which acts as a retention window for deleted data (dropbox-docs-47, dropbox-docs-14, dropbox-docs-25). These windows are fixed by plan tier rather than set by the user, so there is no evidence of real control over retention. missing for 10: user-configurable retention policies, documented permanent/immediate deletion or purge, controls over retention of data processed by AI features (Dash), data-deletion/account-erasure documentation, independent corroboration.
